Location, Location, Location! Upstairs, prepare to be captivated by some of the most spectacular ocean, beach, and mountain views Pierpont Bay has to offer. Enjoy breathtaking sunrises and sunsets, watch sailboats drift across the horizon, and take in the stunning island vistas from the comfort of your own home. Additional highlights include a two-car garage and driveway with parking for two additional vehicles, owned solar panels, a Tesla battery, EV charging, a fire pit, and loads of extra storage! Ideally located across from Pierpont Elementary School and just a short distance to the Ventura Harbor, Marina Park, and San Buenaventura State Beach, where scenic walkways and bike paths lead to the California Street Promenade, the Ventura Pier, the Ventura County Fairgrounds, Surfers Point, and charming historic downtown Ventura with its shops, restaurants, and vibrant coastal atmosphere. Continue along the coastline and the path stretches all the way to Carpinteria and Santa Barbara, or head inland to the beautiful Ojai Valley. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own your dream home and embrace the exceptional Pierpont Bay Beach lifestyle.
